workouts.name: TATA MUMBAI MARATHON
workouts.description: Race day.
workouts.humanReadable: Goal 3:45 (5:20/km). Km 0-5: 5:25-5:28. Km 5-30: 5:18-5:22, HR 158 or below. Km 30+: hold or push if HR allows. Gel every 30 min.

run.notes: Km 0-5 at 5:25-5:28 (crowded, dark, humid). Don't chase pace on Bandra-Worli Sea Link incline — hold effort. Bank nothing. Expect late-race rise toward Peddar Road / Marine Drive and rising heat after ~7 am: if temp >24°C / very humid, add 5-10 s/km and race HR, not pace. Halfway target ~1:53.

nutrition.preRace: Wake 3:00-3:15. 2.5-3 h before: 100-150 g carbs low-fibre (white bread/jam/banana/rice) + 500 ml fluid w/ electrolytes. Gel 15 min pre-start.

products: Gel every 30 min (same brand as long runs)

nutrition.notes: Rehearse exact fuel on wk 7, 9, 10 long runs. Carb load Fri-Sat (8-10 g/kg/day). Nothing new on race day.

taper.notes: Wk 11 ~-30%, wk 12 ~-55% excl race. Keep MP touches. Lower-body lifting light wk 11, none wk 12.
